scenes.headline:
You can already see
what should be fixed
scenes.say: Somewhere right now, there's an administrator who can see exactly what should be fixed.

scenes.headline: A spreadsheet. A group chat. / And no permission
scenes.say: You've got a spreadsheet, a WhatsApp group, and no permission.

scenes.headline: We got tired of waiting too
scenes.say: We're a Guardian Life branch in Chaguanas. We got tired of waiting too.

scenes.headline: Thirty-six files. / A hundred thousand lines
scenes.say: So we wrote our own software. Thirty six files. About a hundred thousand lines. Nobody here was hired as a developer.

scenes.headline: What you would actually work on
scenes.say: Here is what you would actually work on.

scenes.headline: Logged, routed, / signed for
scenes.say: The Log Book. Every document that leaves this branch, logged, routed, and signed for on a phone.

scenes.headline: A letter before it lapses
scenes.say: The Premium Due Desk. Before a policy lapses, the client gets a letter, and a person checks every single one.

scenes.headline: Line by line, / before anybody pays
scenes.say: Group billing. An insurer's invoice, checked line by line against our own records, before anybody pays it.

scenes.headline: Half the work. / Half making it smaller
scenes.say: Half of your day is that work. The other half is making it smaller.

scenes.headline: By hand today. / A script tomorrow
scenes.say: You take a job you do by hand, and you turn it into a script that does it for you.

scenes.headline: You get the keys. / Not a request form
scenes.say: You would be writing Apps Script, working in Salesforce and Google Workspace, with Claude beside you. Already paid for, already connected. You get the keys, not a request form.

words3: Tell us what you would fix.
scenes.say: One administrator's seat. Chaguanas. Come and build with us.
